mainEntity.name: Is it safe to give AI tools my customer information and business data?

acceptedAnswer.text: Protect customer and business information by minimizing what you share, checking the provider’s current data and privacy terms, and using separate accounts or restricted permissions where appropriate. Run My AI Biz stresses secure account connections and owner control, but the correct safeguards depend on the platforms and information involved. Context: Avoid treating a general chatbot as a secure records system without checking its settings and contractual terms. Key factors: - Do not paste unnecessary passwords, payment details, private customer records, or confidential documents. - Remove identifying details when they are not needed for the task. - Review retention, training, deletion, access, and integration settings. Practical guidance: Create a simple data-classification rule showing what may be used, what must be redacted, and what must stay outside the workflow. Recheck provider terms before connecting email, payment, customer-support, or storage accounts.
acceptedAnswer.description: Share only the minimum information required, remove identifying details when possible, and review each provider’s retention, training, deletion, access, and integration settings. Keep passwords, payment details, and unnecessary confidential records out of general AI prompts.
